name: See Nobody Cares
look: Two stills from Jurassic Park at an outdoor cafe under thatched umbrellas. Top: Wayne Knight as Dennis Nedry, in glasses and a pink floral Hawaiian shirt, shouts with his arm raised beside a man in a red polo and straw hat. Bottom: Nedry smirks and gestures at the man.
use: Proves nobody is paying attention. The top panel is a loud announcement, overshare or thing someone worried about, and the bottom panel is Nedry's smug follow-up, 'See, nobody cares.'
slots: top panel: the loud announcement or worry
examples: I'M ON DAY THREE OF MY JUICE CLEANSE!
Hey everyone, I finally changed my profile picture!
describe: jurassic park guy in a hawaiian shirt shouting at a cafe
nedry yelling across an outdoor restaurant then shrugging
man in glasses and a flowered shirt making a scene at lunch
two panel jurassic park scene proving no one is listening
guy in tropical shirt yells then says no one is paying attention
origin: From Jurassic Park (1993): Dennis Nedry loudly shouts his nervous contact's name across a cafe to prove nobody is listening.
